name: CFBench
description: CFBench is a large-scale comprehensive constraints-following benchmark for LLMs, featuring 1,000 curated samples covering over 200 real-life scenarios and 50+ NLP tasks. It evaluates LLMs' ability to understand and follow complex natural language constraints integrated within instructions.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark that has gained attention in the constraints-following LLM evaluation literature, but is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Includes a systematic framework of constraint types and integrates user perception in evaluation.
